title: Phone catch-up is one current digest, not a replay of every update in order

requirements.text: When the phone app comes back with two or more unheard replies, it speaks one digest instead of each reply in order
requirements.check: manual: phone away 15 min with 3 updates -> one spoken digest

requirements.text: The digest drops or folds updates that are stale by now (a question since settled by a decision)
requirements.check: manual: a settled question is not read out

requirements.text: Every update is still in the conversation list to scroll back to
requirements.check: eye: replies listed under the digest

text: Planned only. TJ also asked (phone): pause other apps' music during readouts - built under T-HMHNF, not here.
